user.title: Family calendar
user.description: Choose the calendar whose event titles start with the initials of the people concerned. Every person gets a calendar of their own.

data_description.name: Name of the device that groups the person calendars.
data_description.source_calendar: The calendar whose events are split up. It stays unchanged.

data_description.name: Shown as the name of the person's calendar.
data_description.letter: The letter that marks this person's events, e.g. F in "F Dentist" or "CF Parents' evening".
data_description.color: Color of this person's events. Events of several people appear striped.

error.source_is_family_calendar: A person calendar cannot be a source calendar.
error.invalid_letter: The initial must be a single letter.
error.letter_taken: This initial is already used by another person.

abort.already_configured: This calendar is already set up.
